Crop profile

Garlic

Garlic is listed as a Spring crop with a 4-day first harvest and no regrow in the 0.8.10.842 configuration; its seed listing is present, but the captured seed price is unreadable.

Evidence combines public 0.8.10.455 footage with 0.8.10.842 build settings; configuration is not labeled as current hands-on testing.

Seed item settings

Editor-collected game-file settings: Farming classification, Bronze rarity, right-hand slot, equip/stack/drop/sell flags enabled, and Energy consumption 1 / restoration 0. Internal prices are withheld; I2 description slots are empty.

Produce item settings

Names come from the original I2 text. Health/Energy restoration values are game-file settings, not tested safe-to-eat or runtime-effect claims.

  • Garlic — Normal configuration · Health restore 15 · Energy restore 50
    Shop configuration 1Shop configuration 2
  • Giant Garlic — Giant configuration · Health restore 25 · Energy restore 60

All use Farming classification, Bronze rarity, a both-hands slot, and enabled equip/stack/drop/sell flags. Shop references do not guarantee current stock; internal prices are not retail or player-sale values.

  • Garlic Seed appears in the same Leafy Market seed tab, but its price was never readable on screen. Single-sourceGames Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)

What to do next

Use this entry to prepare a Spring garlic planting: confirm the seed listing, keep the plot watered through the 4-day first harvest, and treat the price notes below as a separate reference.

Price and income boundary

  • Garlic (the harvested product, not the seed) retails at 31C in the Leafy Market Vegetables tab, restoring 15 HP / 50 energy. This is a shop purchase price — what a rancher earns for selling garlic is unobserved. Video-observedGames Station gameplay footage V0.8.10.455 (local archive: games-station.mp4, seed tab 03:15–03:50, CashIn 59:41–59:57)
